extension_name.description: Extension name shown in the browser and stores.

extension_description.message: Blurs chats, previews, messages, media and profile pictures on Bale Web until you hover them. No data collection.

setting_enabled_hint.message: Toggle from anywhere with the keyboard shortcut.

setting_revealOnHover_hint.message: Move the pointer over a blurred element to read it.

setting_holdKeyReveal.message: Hold a key to reveal everything

setting_blurOnWindowBlur.message: Blur when the window loses focus

setting_blurOnWindowBlur_hint.message: Overrides the master switch while another window is in front.

setting_blurOnIdle.message: Blur after a period of inactivity

setting_debug_hint.message: Prints how many elements each selector matches to the Bale page console.

options_subtitle.message: Your settings stay in your browser. The extension makes no network requests.

advanced_hint.message: Bale changes its markup from time to time. Add one CSS selector per line to extend a category without waiting for an update.
